name: qbrain-ai-opencode-plugin
description: Clone or update the OpenCode plugin repository for QBrain.AI TODO, session log, requirements, GraphRAG, workspace initialization, and failsafe replay workflows. GitHub repository name stays the current name until the repository rename.
parameterSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"targetParent":{"type":"string","description":"Parent directory where the plugin repository should be cloned or updated"}},"required":["targetParent"]}
commandTemplate: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $parent='{{targetParent}}'; $name='mcpserver-opencode-plugin'; $repo='https://github.com/sharpninja/mcpserver-opencode-plugin.git'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null; $path=Join-Path $parent $name; if(Test-Path (Join-Path $path '.git')){ git -C $path pull --ff-only } elseif(Test-Path $path){ throw ($path + ' exists but is not a git repository') } else { git clone $repo $path }"
